noRevocable.revocado: This consent is already revoked: it can't be revoked again.
noRevocable.parcial: This consent is already revoked in Solventa; only the entities without confirmation still need to respond. You can retry the notice.
noRevocable.vencido: This consent has expired: there is nothing to revoke.

carrera.consent_already_revoked: This consent was already revoked while you were confirming (for example, by the holder from the app). No new request was sent and we updated the status.
carrera.consent_not_active: This consent expired while you were confirming, so it can no longer be revoked. We updated the status.

parcial.titulo: Partial revocation: some entities have not confirmed
parcial.texto: Solventa no longer queries this customer's data, but not every entity confirmed within the 5-minute window.

enCurso.texto: Solventa no longer queries this customer's data. We are notifying the entities: they have until {{ hora }} to confirm.

sondeoDetenido.texto: We stopped checking the status automatically. What you see may not be the latest.

detalle.falloReintento: We couldn't retry the notice to the entities. Nothing was changed: try again.

efecto.texto: Solventa no longer queries this customer's data. The notice to each entity continues within the 5-minute window.

reglas.texto: Only the operations analyst can revoke. The request is sent to every authorized entity and must complete within 5 minutes; if one doesn't process it, you will see an alert and can retry. A consent that is already revoked or expired can't be revoked.

estados.revocation_not_confirmed: The entity did not confirm in time

revocar.introduccion: The revocation request will be sent to every authorized entity. The status will change to Revoked once all of them confirm; if one doesn't respond within 5 minutes, you will see an alert and can retry.
revocar.referenciaAyuda: 3 to 64 characters: unaccented letters, numbers, space and . / # _ -
revocar.confirmoRol: I confirm that I act as compliance officer and that the request is documented.

errores.service_unavailable: We couldn't record the revocation and nothing was changed. We kept what you filled in: press “Revoke now” to try again.
errores.idempotency_key_reused: The request couldn't be processed. Press “Revoke now” to try again.
errores.invalid_request: The request couldn't be processed. Press “Revoke now” to try again.
errores.generico: We couldn't revoke the consent. Try again.
